name: Blendr
source:
Blendr is a short Dating Sim based around an in-game dating app of the same title. You are taken out to a Speed Dating Event by your newly single friend Alyx. While speed dating, you meet Seline: a florist with an odd hobby; Eva: a tough looking, easy going, flirty dog foster; and Gregor: a reclusive basement dweller and totally not a creep…

[From the [url=https://itzbrucelee.itch.io/blendr]official website[/url]]
